description: Compatibility alias for cad.set_object_properties. All hosted stored drawings, including uploads, auto-save; local source files stay unchanged. Only families with a byte-exact writer accept edits — ask cad.describe_type, whose `writable` list names the fields and, for each, the read property holding the same value. A field the family does not declare is refused before anything is changed, so a typo cannot half-apply a batch.

properties.description: Writable field name to typed value, e.g. {"Radius": 5.0}. Names come from cad.describe_type's `writable`, not from the readable property names.

name: cad.set_entity_properties
